fields.trigger: Cumulative passenger cases reached 2 percent at 14:20 on Nov 5, with the vessel 39 hours from Port Canaveral.

items.action: Send the special report for the 2 percent level and telephone the Vessel Sanitation Program.
Advise ill passengers to stay in their cabins until 24 hours after symptoms end.
Keep ill food employees off duty until symptom-free for 48 hours and cleared by the Doctor.
Begin collecting stool or vomitus specimens as the Vessel Sanitation Program directs.
Start the outbreak prevention and response plan cleaning schedule for public areas and high-touch surfaces.
Switch self-service food stations to served portions.
Post hygiene and handwashing notices and send the guest letter.

fields.sources: CDC Vessel Sanitation Program 2025 Environmental Public Health Standards, sections 4.2 to 4.4
